baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction around saying and command, followed by worship of Allah as both my Lord and your Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker restricts his utterance to an imposed command and redirects service toward the Lord shared by speaker and audience. Speech is therefore relay rather than self-authored religious authority.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies an outwardly articulated utterance whose content can be audited.
Binding request supplies the authority upstream of the speaker's words.
Submissive worship supplies the commanded relation and excludes the messenger as its object.
Lordship, ownership, and mastery shared over speaker and audience flatten any claim that the speaker is their lord.

changed_reading.before: A teacher recalls that he taught monotheism.
changed_reading.after: The statement is a precise disclaimer of independent authorship: his entire authorized utterance relayed one command that placed him and them under the same Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: I was over them a witness as long as I remained among them; when You took me fully, You became the watcher over them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human witnessing depends on presence and duration. The taking of the speaker both receives the person and completes his period among them; guarding then remains with the divine watcher without interruption.

activation_trace.role: Presence with direct observation defines the finite human witness.
Continuance and settled duration make co-presence the explicit boundary of that witness.
Taking the soul supplies the personal withdrawal that ends direct co-presence.
Completion without deficiency overlays the withdrawal with closure of the allotted term.
Guarding and preservation supply the continuing divine function after the human witness ends.

changed_reading.before: One observer leaves and another observer replaces him.
changed_reading.after: A presence-dependent human commission reaches closure, while divine custody was and remains uninterrupted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same witness term applies first to the speaker over them and finally to God over every thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated witness root does not equate the witnesses. The first is bounded by being among a group; the second joins comprehensive enclosure and everything knowable or reportable.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration supplies the evidentiary function shared by both clauses.
Enclosure of all parts expands the final witness beyond a local group or interval.
Anything knowable and reportable supplies the unrestricted field of divine testimony.

changed_reading.before: Witness is repeated mainly for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The repetition constructs an asymmetry: locally competent testimony is enclosed within an all-things divine testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier exact duration pattern makes continued state the condition for a rule, while the later self-return sequence assigns each person a report of their own action. Together they recast the speaker's being over them as a bounded evidentiary tenure, not perpetual liability for their later conduct.

activation_trace.role: Duration in the focus marks how long the speaker's direct witness remains operative.
The same continuing-state image makes a legal restriction last only while its named condition persists.
The consecrated state supplies the condition whose duration controls the rule in the parallel construction.
Each self as its own entity supplies the locus of responsibility after guidance.
Return supplies the movement of all persons back to the final evaluator.
A delivered report of deeds makes later accountability informationally direct rather than mediated by the former human witness.

structural_cues: 5:96 uses the exact duration construction around a state-dependent rule that 5:117 uses around witnessing.
5:105 places self-care, universal return, and disclosure of deeds before the testimony scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the duration parallel and individual return-report sequence; I infer that co-presence bounds an evidentiary office rather than ownership of later behavior. A live alternative is that the parallel marks time only, without implying office.

changed_reading.before: The speaker merely says that he stopped seeing them after his departure.
changed_reading.after: He marks the expiry of a condition-bound witness tenure while leaving each follower answerable for the period beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated limitation of the messenger to delivery, followed by fabricated claims placed on God and then a direct question about what the speaker said, turns the focus denial into a provenance audit. The issue is not only whether the doctrine is correct but where the contested saying entered the chain.

activation_trace.role: The branch of attributing an unsaid saying makes the focus denial answer a possible false assignment of words.
Messenger and message supply the delegated position in the transmission chain.
Delivery of a message defines the messenger's positive task.
Repeated message delivery reinforces the exclusive limit on messenger responsibility.
Invented falsehood supplies a mechanism by which unauthorized religious content can be manufactured.
Contradiction of truth supplies the quality of the manufactured attribution.
The direct interrogation and denial activate the branch of words falsely assigned to a speaker.

structural_cues: 5:92 and 5:99 repeat an exclusive messenger-delivery formula.
5:103 names fabrication on God, and 5:116 asks whether the focus speaker originated the disputed saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited delivery, fabricated attribution, and the direct saying-question; I infer a chain-of-custody problem for religious speech. A live alternative is that these are parallel moral themes without a technical provenance relation.

changed_reading.before: The speaker says that he obeyed and taught correctly.
changed_reading.after: He identifies the sole authorized source and content of his speech, denying that the contested claim entered through him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testamentary witness procedure tests testimony for truth, proper form, concealment, and replacement; the next scene examines messengers about the response they received. The focus speech consequently reads as a deposition that states its evidence, temporal competence, and point of epistemic surrender.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration anchors the focus as evidentiary speech.
Formal testimony supplies the legal register immediately preceding the messenger examination.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the criterion by which competing testimony is corrected.
The right face of an affair supplies the requirement that testimony arrive in its proper form.
A returned answer makes reception of the message the object of examination.
Knowledge disclosed to its knower marks both the messengers' limit and divine competence.
What is hidden from sight supplies the domain the human witnesses explicitly yield.

structural_cues: The 5:106-108 witness procedure directly precedes the 5:109 gathering and questioning of messengers.
The focus answer names what was said, what was observed, the duration of competence, and the superior witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a legal witness protocol followed by messenger questioning; I infer that its evidentiary grammar carries into the focus answer. A live alternative is a looser thematic echo of truthfulness rather than a deposition structure.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a theological recollection by a former teacher.
changed_reading.after: It is an auditable deposition: authorized words, observed interval, termination of competence, and referral of hidden evidence to the all-knowing witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Four permission markers enclose acts that look creative or life-giving. The focus command marker performs the same containment for speech: extraordinary efficacy does not convert delegated action into independent lordship or a claim to worship.

activation_trace.role: Binding command supplies the authorization boundary around the focus speech.
Submissive worship fixes the relation that extraordinary agency must not redirect toward the speaker.
Repeated permission explicitly licenses each extraordinary operation.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the strongest apparent case of independent power that permission contains.
Sending breath into a form supplies the operative transition toward animation.
Coming to be in time supplies the resulting state while leaving its authorization visible.

structural_cues: 5:110 repeats by My permission four times around formation, animation, healing, and bringing forth the dead.
5:116 then tests whether the beneficiary of those acts converted delegated power into a claim of deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated permission around extraordinary acts and command around speech; I infer a common anti-inflation boundary on agency. A live alternative is that permission merely recalls favor without defining the logic of the focus denial.

changed_reading.before: The speaker was an obedient teacher despite having performed signs.
changed_reading.after: The focus statement closes the authorization ledger: neither potent acts nor authoritative words escaped divine permission and command, so neither can ground worship of the agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disciples move from hidden divine prompting and a request for the speaker's witness, through a material table sought for settled hearts and verified truth, to a warning against covering the received favor. Being witness over them therefore includes observing how a community receives, verifies, and answers disclosed grace.

activation_trace.role: Presence with observation anchors the speaker's witness to the community's lived response.
Divine inspiration supplies the hidden initiating address behind the disciples' declared belief.
Their request for an informed declaration makes the speaker witness their professed submission.
The food-bearing table supplies the inspectable material sign around which response develops.
Settled assurance supplies the internal change the requested sign is meant to produce.
Truthful speech supplies what the sign is asked to verify.
Their aspiration to become witnesses extends observation from the messenger to the recipients.
Covering a favor supplies the accountable reversal possible after the sign is received.

structural_cues: 5:111-115 forms a progression from prompted belief, to demanded proof, to witness formation, to liability after receipt.
The focus places the speaker among this same group only for a delimited interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies profession, sign request, verification, witness language, and warning; I infer that the focus witness tracks the community's response to disclosed grace. A live alternative is that he witnesses only their words and outward acts, not the full response process.

changed_reading.before: He generally observed the conduct of his followers while present.
changed_reading.after: He witnessed a community cross from professed submission through demanded verification into accountable possession of a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: After ending his witness tenure, the speaker names the people as God's servants and leaves punishment and forgiveness within divine wisdom. Truth then benefits its bearers, and universal kingdom and capacity close the scene. The focus command to worship the shared Lord is thus also a renunciation of ownership, verdict, and disposal over the followers.

activation_trace.role: Worshipful submission establishes the relation directed solely to God.
Shared lordship makes the speaker a subject under the same master rather than owner of the group.
Servants under ownership place the people directly within God's jurisdiction.
Protective covering of sin supplies one possible divine disposition of their case.
Accurate wisdom supplies the competence governing punishment or forgiveness.
Benefit opposite harm supplies the adjudicated effect of truth on its speakers.
Truthful saying identifies what survives and benefits in the final evaluation.
Universal sovereignty supplies the ownership under which the entire testimony closes.
Effective capacity supplies the power to carry the final disposition into effect.

structural_cues: 5:118 immediately follows the transfer to divine watch and calls the accused group Your servants.
5:119 adjudicates truthful speech, and 5:120 closes with universal sovereignty and capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies servant status, divine disposition, truth's benefit, and universal rule; I infer a return of jurisdiction that the speaker never possessed independently. A live alternative is that these closing claims console rather than formally allocate jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: God watches the followers after their messenger is gone.
changed_reading.after: Their persons, evidence, verdict, and outcome remain wholly in the shared Lord's jurisdiction; the former witness neither owns them nor claims their final disposal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for ق و ل. It remains anchored in the focus imperative and its exclusive construction, and the repeated delivery limit supports the image of compression. Downstream prose should present it only as split-root wordplay, never as a replacement for the ordinary saying sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: I said nothing except what You commanded me.

activation_trace.role: Littleness and scantness make the exclusive clause image the speaker's utterance compressed to the minimum authorized content.
Delivery alone supplies a contextual pressure toward minimal rather than expansive messenger authorship.

changed_reading.before: The speaker reports the correct content of a potentially broad teaching ministry.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the utterance is reduced almost to a single small payload: only the commanded redirection of worship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the neck or whole-person branch activated by the literal neck in 5:89 color the divine watcher. It remains anchored in the focus رقيب and in the following servant status, but it must stay a custodial overlay on guarding and observation, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: You were the watcher over them.

activation_trace.role: Guarding and preservation provide the primary anchored sense of divine watch.
The neck standing for a whole person adds an exploratory image of custody encompassing persons rather than detached surveillance.
The literal emancipated neck activates the whole-person and liability dimension of the shared root.
Servants under ownership keep the custodial overlay tied to persons under divine jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The watcher continuously observes the absent messenger's followers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine watching is whole-person custody: their persons and liabilities remain guarded when the human witness can no longer stand over them.

strongest_changes: The exact duration parallel and individual-return sequence turn presence into a bounded witness tenure rather than perpetual responsibility.
Messenger-only delivery, fabricated attribution, and direct interrogation make the focus denial an audit of message provenance.
The preceding testamentary procedure converts witness language into a deposition with stated evidence, competence, and epistemic limits.

Repeated permission around extraordinary acts prevents delegated efficacy from becoming independent lordship, while the closing servant, truth, kingdom, and capacity sequence returns all jurisdiction to God.
summary.what_was_special: The packet joined legal duration, transmission limits, formal witness correction, repeated permission, material verification, and final sovereignty around one compact answer. The focus consequently became not just doctrinal denial but a bounded evidentiary handoff.
remaining_uncertainties: The completion branch of توفيتني sharpens closure of tenure but does not by itself decide the mode of the speaker's taking.
The legal deposition model is structurally strong, though the degree to which every testamentary rule transfers into the messenger scene remains inferential.
The scant-speech and neck-custody readings depend on deliberately exploratory branch crossings and should remain visibly qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Witnessing transfers when presence ends.** `ش ه د B001` is presence, `د و م B001` continued remaining, `و ف ي B002` taking the soul in full, and `ر ق ب B001` watchful waiting. The temporal clauses delimit Jesus's direct observation. I infer a transfer from local embodied witness to unbounded divine surveillance after departure.
2. **Speech remains constrained to delegated command.** `ء م ر B002` is directive and `ع ب د B003` submissive worship. I infer that faithful messengership transmits only authorized content, directly answering the unauthorized attribution in 5:116.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Finite presence bounds messenger-witness, then full taking transfers surveillance.** Fixed **و ف ي / B002** (“receiving the soul in full as death or sleep”) marks the transition in *tawaffaytanī*, while fixed **ر ق ب / B001** (“watching and expectant waiting”) and **B002** (“guarding and keeping”) name the continuing oversight. The ayah limits Jesus’s witness to “while I remained among them”; 5:116 established one-way knowledge of interiors, and 5:119 validates truthful speech at judgment. I infer that removal ends local observation without leaving an evidentiary gap because unrestricted watch succeeds it. The testimony reads as an explicit handoff of oversight.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:119 confirmed that bounded but truthful witness remains beneficial under the unrestricted audit, and 5:120 located both witnesses and outcomes inside total dominion.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإمرة والإمارة والولاية، والأمير والمؤمر، وتولية شخص أميرا أو تسلطه.

يدخل فيه الإمر أو الإمرة للرجل الضعيف الرأي أو الأحمق الذي يستأمر كل أحد ويأتمر لكل أمر.
يدخل فيه الإمر لولد الضأن أو الخروف، والإمرة للأنثى أو الرخل.
يدخل فيه الأمر بمعنى الإبداع والإنشاء المختص بالله، والتعبير عن سرعة الإيجاد بالقول.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان
يدخل فيه الرباني لرئيس الملاحين

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde artma ve yükselme bulunur; bu çekirdek yükselmiş araziye, işlemde anaparayı aşan koşullu fazlalığa, yükselip sıkışan soluğa ve beslenerek büyümeye uzanır. Ayrıca uyluk kökü anatomisi ile baba tarafından yakın hane halkını anlatan dar bir ifade, merkezden ayrı sözlüksel dallar oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak hazır bulunma ve görme çekirdeğini verir; hac yeri ve eşi yanında olan kadın gibi kullanımlar yapıya bağlı özel yüzlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bir yerde hazır bulunması ve çoğu bağlamda olayı doğrudan görerek deneyimlemesidir. Bu çekirdekten, insanların bulunduğu yer, belli ibadet yerleri ve yanında eşi bulunan kadın gibi bağlı kullanımlar doğar.

facets.statement: Bir olayın ya da yerin yanında hazır bulunma ve onu doğrudan görme çekirdeği vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kıpırdamadan, değişmeden veya yerinden ayrılmadan kalması dalın temelidir.

Bir eylemin sürdüğü süreyi bildiren yapı, zaman içindeki kesintisizliği dilbilgisel bir çerçevede belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin hiçbir eksiği kalmadan tamamına ve gereken düzeye erişmesi ya da bu tamlığın sağlanmasıdır. Söz ve şartların yerine getirilmesi, ölçü ve tartının tam verilmesi, hak ile ücretin eksiksiz ödenmesi ve bir şeyin bütününün alınması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey bütün gerekleri karşılanarak tam ve eksiksiz hale gelir ya da bu hale getirilir.
Söz, antlaşma veya şart bağlamında üstlenilen yükümlülük eksiksiz yerine getirilir ve bozulmaz.
Ölçü, tartı, hak veya ücret bağlamında verilmesi gereken miktar hiçbir eksiltme yapılmadan verilir.
Bir şey ya da belirli bir sayı, hiçbir parçası geride bırakılmadan bütünüyle alınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı eksiksiz tamamlanma düşüncesini; söz ve şartların yerine getirilmesinde, ölçü ve ödemede tamlığın sağlanmasında ve bir şeyin bütününün alınmasında sürdürür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifade ölümde canın alınmasını ve yaşamın sona ermesini açıkça bildirir; ayrıca ölümü ayrılan sürenin tamamlanmasıyla açıklar ve aynı anlatımı uyku sırasında bilincin askıya alınmasına genişletir. Dal çerçevesi bu iki kullanımı doğru biçimde bir arada tutar.

Uyku sırasında bilinç ve ayırt etme yetisi uykuya dalışla birlikte geçici olarak askıya alınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüm anlamını canın alınması ve yaşamın sona ermesiyle birleştirir; bunu yaşam süresinin tamamlanması olarak açıklar ve aynı anlatımı uyku sırasında bilincin geçici kesilmesine genişletir.

root_profile.summary: Anlam örgüsünün merkezinde bir şeyi eksiksiz tamamlama, tam verme veya bütününü alma bulunur; ölüm ve uyku dalı da canın ya da bilinç süresinin bütünüyle alınması düşüncesiyle buna bağlanır.
